(Currently amended) Claim 1: An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device further __includes a processing unit to facilitate computation of the alignment__.

(Currently amended) Claim 2: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment.

(Currently amended) Claim 3: The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface.

(Currently amended) Claim 5: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment.

(Currently amended) Claim 6: The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface.

(Currently amended) Claim 9: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein __the similarity metric also considers contextual information about the user actions__.

(Currently amended) Claim 10: The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment.

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.

(Currently amended) Claim 17: A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step utilizes a __processing unit to facilitate the computation__.

(Currently amended) Claim 20: The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment.

(Currently amended) Claim 21: The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface.

(Currently amended) Claim 23: The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein __the similarity metric also considers contextual information about the user actions__.

(Currently amended) Claim 24: The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device.

(Currently amended) Claim 25: The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure.
